## Specifications

- **Max tire circumference**: up to 33" [t606] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Stock tire width**: 265/74R16 [t606] ([Partial] [Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- Note that this feature is specific to the second generation (2005+), as earlier models lacked it. [t606]
- Be aware that the PRO-4X speedometer is calibrated for its specific stock tires. [t606]
